violation_type.code_system: Texas Administrative Code, Title 26, Ch. HRC42
violation_type.title: HRC42.063(a)(3) - Reporting incidents and violations-an illness of a child that requires hospitalization (26 TAC §HRC42.063(a)(3) - Reporting incidents an)
violation_type.short_title: HRC42.063(a)(3) - Reporting incidents and violations-an illness of a child that requires hospitalization
violation_type.typical_finding: During a DFPS investigation, there was a child who was taken to the hospital due to a high fever. The operation failed to report the incident to childcare regulation.
